verdict.rationale: mParticle documents rule-like automation on its event stream: forwarding rules conditioned on consent state decide whether event data goes downstream, and audiences built from behavioral data activate automatically once connected to an output. These are narrow, suppression- and segmentation-oriented rules, not a general event-to-action rules engine. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose event-triggered rules or action builder, configurable action types beyond forwarding or suppression, depth docs on trigger conditions and timing, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Applying a forwarding rule of: Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present.
